encoding: base64 unsigned varints of zigzag longitude/latitude deltas; each ring restarts at 0,0

processing.simplification: None: every polygon, hole and source vertex is retained
processing.antimeridian: Use source-split polygons; all source edges checked for longitude jumps <=180 degrees
processing.displayCustomization: For this atlas only, source code PS has the regional display label הלבנט. This is a display preference, not a sovereignty determination.

limitations: Generalized country/area polygons, not an address geocoder or legal boundary map.
A click near a generalized coast or border may have no polygon match; use a latitude-region fallback rather than the nearest country.
Country/area labels follow the pinned source except the explicitly documented regional display label.
